newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Etol to be listed on Ljubljana bourse.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Etol to be listed on Ljubljana bourse.

text.p: Slovenian etheral oil and aroma maker Etol is poised to list its shares on the main market of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange, but no date has yet been set for the start of trading, the bourse said on Monday.
The company will list 192,627 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 10,000 tolars ($73) each, representing 66.8 percent of its equity, the bourse said.
Etol will join a batch of 22 newly privatised companies that have been listed on the main or over-the-counter (OTC) markets of the Ljubljana bourse since the start of the year.
Currently there are 22 companies listed on the main market, while 27 are being traded on the OTC segment of the bourse. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana Newsroom, 386 61 1263 644
